Package com.framed.interop.mqtt

Interface MqttTransport

All Known Implementing Classes:
PahoMqttTransport
public interface MqttTransport
Minimal MQTT transport abstraction used by MqttService. Keeps the bridge logic independent of any particular client library, so it can be exercised with an in-memory fake in tests and backed by PahoMqttTransport in production.

      void subscribe(String topicFilter, int qos, BiConsumer<String,byte[]> handler) throws Exception
      Subscribes to a topic filter, delivering matching messages to handler as (topic, payload).
      Parameters:
      topicFilter - the MQTT topic filter (may contain + / # wildcards)
      qos - the requested QoS
      handler - receives (topic, payload) for each matching message

      Exception - if subscribing fails
